title: Multi Hook Wall Mount Rack, 6 Position, 15.5-Inch, Solid Brass | Mediterranean Blue | Brass Multi Hooks | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling towels, robes, and belts on the counter—this wall-mount multi hook creates an organized, easy-to-grab storage zone in your bathroom in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Save space with a wall-mounted design ideal for smaller bathrooms
  • Choose enduring materials crafted from solid brass
  • Coordinate your look with the distinctive design of the Brass Multi Hooks collection and multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation
Material: Solid brass
Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware included
Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3.2 x 4 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 6 x 4 in.
Shipping weight: 3 lbs
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
